caption:
Figure 1: SWIM. (a) The behavioral predictor learns coordinate weights from current states, gated future
changes, and logged actions. (b) Frozen weights rescale standardized states. Squared latent and state distances
from the same frame pairs enter the correlation loss, with state distances held fixed; prediction and SIGReg
losses are retained. The inset names physical features before standardization and shows illustrative weight bars;
within this inset, θ denotes a joint angle. The training symbols are defined in Sections 4.1–4.2. Deployment uses
image-based latent planning; the behavioral predictor and logged future states are training-only components.
